_argsComment: ${APP_TIMEZONE} is the bare form — CommandBox expands ${VAR}, not
${env.VAR}. The old ${env.APP_TIMEZONE} silently resolved to empty,
so the running JVM carried a bare `-Duser.timezone=`. box.json's
cfmigrations block already used the correct bare form.
The OOM flags turn heap exhaustion into a heap dump plus a fast
restart instead of a silent multi-hour outage: without
ExitOnOutOfMemoryError the JVM survives its own OOM and thrashes GC
forever, so the container never exits, `restart: unless-stopped`
never fires, and /__health keeps answering 200 while the site is
unusable. HeapDumpPath points at the backups mount, which is bound
to a host path in both site composes, so a dump outlives the
container. Budget disk for it — a dump is up to the full heap size.

_comment: 5.C — gzipEnable is set for future-compat, but the Ortus CommandBox
image's entry point doesn't surface the setting to Runwar in this
build. Production serves the app behind NGINX (Phase 10 B14); the
edge does gzip + brotli there. Leaving the flag on so a straight
`box server start` in another environment picks it up automatically.
